actual_scope: Exact scalar census, on the PR5907 P104 word, of helper splits with the shape of PR5718: a helper retired at a strictly intermediate chart with a unit injection of a new independent helper, an input functional on group, U-initial or empty-frame-initial roles, and output normalisation only on roles whose final chart is V. scope_change_reason: The card asks for a complete legal split with its invoice. PR5994 excluded PR5599-type splits on PR5907 and named PR5718-type splits as the remaining route; this package tests that route's scalar necessary condition and locates where a mid-word correction would be needed, without building a supplier.
bottleneck_link: Complex currently binds the selected assembly; a zero-paid helper split adds H_r+H_s-H_(r+s) per LOCAL to the productive side. This census says which split shapes remain possible on the latest conditional P104 word.
stop_rule: Stop at one exact census with calibration; do not build or price a split.
